Statistics: no standard JEE problem book chapter confirmed, so only NCERT Exemplar is listed.
Neha Agrawal (Mathematically Inclined) videos are marked english; she teaches mainly in English with occasional Hindi.
Several Neha Agrawal videos cover two chapters together (Matrices & Determinants, Conic Sections, Vectors & 3D, Limits/Continuity/Derivatives, Differential Equations & Area).

math-conditional-probability: no dedicated one-shot found; uses the PW Manzil Probability one-shot and Neha Agrawal's JEE Advanced Probability video, assumed to cover conditional probability, Bayes and random variables (contents not checked minute by minute).
math-logarithms: no dedicated free formula sheet found, so notes are empty.

math-methods-of-differentiation, math-application-of-derivatives, math-area-under-curves, math-conditional-probability: the eSaral PDFs don't cover these topics, so only the Aakash formula page is listed.
ncert_useful is false for Trigonometric Equations and Quadratic Equations because the rationalised NCERT has little or nothing on these; true elsewhere.
